name: Independent startup reference for the full annulus
scope: Accuracy only. The same stored FP64 FD equations, boundary conditions, pow2 row scaling and SBDF2 are used in each independent arm. Apply the original three grids and four weighted norms at six absolute startup times. Mark a relative norm undefined if its denominator is at or below 1e-12 times the maximum finest-reference norm across the six times on that grid and metric, or FP64 tiny if larger. Record the absolute error and refuse qualification for an undefined metric. Compose axis errors within each grid, time and metric. This empirical reference budget is not a certified PDE error bound.
